issues.description: The verified member-function replacement for `Default::default` lacks a comment preserving the original upstream trait implementation pattern.
issues.rationale: `VmSpace::default` is introduced as an inherent method because its tracked arguments and precondition cannot be expressed on the original `Default` implementation in this Verus setup. A collaborator first asks that the original `impl Default for VmSpace { fn default() -> Self { Self::new() } }` be retained as a comment, then clarifies that the conversion itself is acceptable but the source pattern must be visible for future upstream synchronization and rebasing. The author agrees that the documentation is useful and promises an annotation PR. The selected final head still contains only the converted inherent method, with no adjacent original-code comment, so the accepted maintainability request remains unresolved. No same-version published guideline provides a stable rule identifier; the reviewer instead cites the repository's existing converted `RwLockWriteGuard::drop` pattern as precedent.
issues.verification: source-only; historical Rust and Verus were not executed. Independently checked the fixed final source, actual merge-base, complete archived/live discussion, absence of later PR commits, and the immutable linked repository precedent. The accepted documentation request remains unresolved in the selected head.
